title: Classifier benchmark protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Classifier benchmark should complete this objective: Compare logistic regression, SVM, and random forests. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Understand model trade-offs.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Use a consistent split and metric; include one runtime or interpretability trade-off.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for LogisticRegression, SVC, RandomForestClassifier and does not run the learner code. Use a consistent split and metric; include one runtime or interpretability trade-off.
